title: Eight ways work gets stuck: choose the page structure
question: The eight pattern URLs stay exactly as they are; this is composition. Lock one structure, steer it, or re-roll.

options.label: One business, eight hotspots
options.thesis: The homepage's miniature business becomes the map: a numbered pin on each spot where a pattern shows up.
materials: eight numbered pins with pill tags
a zoomed diorama crop beside each entry
options.viewport: Title, lead and booking at left; the diorama at right with eight pins and tags, each linking to its entry.
options.risk: Reuses the homepage's hero image at full size, so the page can feel like a second homepage unless the pins lead.

options.label: Check what you recognize
options.thesis: Tick the signs you've seen; the patterns behind them rise to the top, then book a Walkthrough with them.
options.viewport: A cloud of real signal chips at left; your likely patterns ranked at right with a Walkthrough button.
options.risk: Interactive by design: without JavaScript it must still read as a plain list, and the meters must never look like a score.

options.label: Cards on the desk
options.thesis: Eight pattern cards laid out on the owner's desk, one just picked up.
options.viewport: Title and booking at left; the desk at right with eight readable cards fanned on the blotter.
options.risk: Close kin to the Walkthrough's desk; the cards must stay readable links, not a decorative spread.
